transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this formulary committee review. The item before us today is the request to make emergency hydroxocobalamin rescue kits available for clinical use. As part of our routine review process, I'd like to hear from the requesting clinical department and pharmacy supply operations before we finalize any decision. I understand we haven't yet recorded a final location, quantity, storage arrangement, or staff-readiness plan for the kits, so I'd appreciate input on those implementation details as well. Who would like to begin?
